parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a flat, slightly contoured surface designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: The seat can pivot upward when the chair is folded and downward when unfolded for use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the folding chair, made of tubular steel. It includes the frame, legs, and backrest support structure.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural integrity, stability, and folding functionality to the chair. It supports the seat and backrest while allowing the chair to collapse for storage.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that allow the legs and backrest to fold inward, enabling compact storage and easy transport.
